root_cause: The pricing page primarily segmented by generic package size and operating cadence. That made it harder for materially different buyer contexts such as growth, turnaround, distress, buy-side M&A, sell-side exit preparation and portfolio oversight to identify the correct commercial entry point.
prevention_rule: Pricing pages for Bedrijfsgeheugen must preserve the canonical product ladder while also mapping materially different business situations to explicit first-step offers, indicative pricing, decision models and next actions. High-urgency/distress paths must clearly separate business/data support from regulated legal or insolvency advice.

evidence.outcome: Pricing can now route growth, loss/recovery, acute continuity, buy-side, sell-side and investor/portfolio visitors to a transparent first step with explicit price guidance and relevant analytical models.
